snippet.title: Haul Yeah! | Official Gameplay Trailer — Load It. Strap It. Drive It.
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091040/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=haul_yeah_wishlist&utm_content=official_trailer

Load it. Strap it. Drive it.

Haul Yeah! is a colourful delivery-driving sandbox where loading the truck is half the job. Stack awkward cargo, tighten the straps and make it across a mountain county in one piece—solo or with a mate in split-screen co-op.

• Pack it your way: pick up parcels by hand, balance tall loads and thread straps over the cargo. Real physics means every bump matters.
• Haul with a mate: share the job in two-player local split-screen, or invite a friend through Steam Remote Play Together using one copy of the game.
• Build your business: earn cash and XP, unlock better trucks, create your courier and customise your truck with paint and parts.
• Keep the deliveries moving: explore back roads and changing weather, recover spilled parcels, call a tow truck or unlock a drone rescue.

Wishlist Haul Yeah! on Steam to follow the game and get notified when it becomes available.

Official game page: https://moonjump.com/games/
Steam community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3091040

Developed by Moonjump.

#HaulYeah #IndieGame #Coop
